title: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/SOURCES SOUGHT ? NON-PERSONAL ACQUISITION ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SUPPORT AND LOGISTICS (PSL) SUPPORT TO THE MARITIME ELECTROMAGNETIC WARFARE DIVISION- PSC R706 - NAICS 541330
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC CRANE
detail_text: This purpose of this amendment to Request for Information/Sources Sought Notice is to update submission instructions for responses to the RFI/SS and extend the submission deadline to 29 April 2026. Responses shall be submitted via the PIEE Solicitation Module (PSM) Unsolicited Proposal Tab or via email to the POCs identified in this notice. If vendors submit a response using the unsolicited proposal tab, notify the POCs identified in this announcement.
